plan.authorization: Nicole: are the 10/24 and 7/24 scores actually better than chance? can you check that?
plan.scope: User-requested retrospective inference on the already locked semantic scores. Supersedes the earlier no-new-significance scope for this separate analysis only; rubric and scores unchanged.
plan.analysis_selection: Released encoding, choice question, first and adjacent windows, all24 cases each. Fixed before computing new p-values. No subset/encoding/description search.
plan.score: Full category match only. Ambiguous, vague, abstaining and other answers always zero. No partial credit or recoding.
plan.primary_null: No association between judged answer categories and eight task identities. Enumerate all8! label permutations, applying the SAME permutation across all three seeds. Preserve answer preferences, invalid answers and cross-seed task dependence. Count number of permutations with score >= observed, including identity, divided by40320.
plan.secondary_null: Within each of the four fixed training pairs, can answers distinguish its two tasks? Enumerate all2^4 label swaps, again shared across seeds; preserve broad pair identity. Same right-tail exact calculation. This separates broad family recognition from which task within the pair.
plan.multiplicity: Report raw and Holm-adjusted p-values across all four planned tests: two windows x two nulls. Alpha.05 for descriptive decisions.
limitations: Exploratory post-hoc semantic judging by assistant already exposed to some results; no independent confirmation.
Eight fixed toy categories and three reused initialization seeds, not24 independent problems.
Label-exchangeability null is a conditional association benchmark, not actual random assignment of training tasks or evidence about a broad task population.
Within-pair null has only16 permutations; coarse p-values and limited power.
Above overall null can arise from recognizing broad training topics; it does not establish faithful factual explanations, causal selectivity, or reliability on every update.
plan.outputs: Exact null histograms/counts, all four p-values, per-seed/per-task contributions, new plot and report section. Preserve original strict and semantic records. No model calls or new experiments.
